1. Take ln(1 + f) of every value.
2. Extend the result with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
3. Take the 2D FFT and multiply each frequency by H.
4. Take the inverse FFT and keep the real part.
5. Crop the extension.
6. Return exp of the result minus 1, stretched to the full range by default.
